title: [review] provisioning.py:354: Identity.from_seed called with
description: session.provisioned_seed is typed as bytes | None and could be None if provision_node() was never called or failed. Passing None to Identity.from_seed() will cause a runtime error or produce invalid cryptographic output.
close_reason: Fixed: Added None check before calling Identity.from_seed(session.provisioned_seed) at line 354. The provisioned_seed field is bytes | None and could be None if provision_node() was never called or failed. Now the callback is only invoked when both the callback and seed are present.
